questions.question: How long is the process on average?
questions.answer: The entire process typically takes 2-3 weeks from initial consultation to receiving your medication. This includes the consultation, prescription review, and expedited delivery to your doorstep.

questions.question: Are there any additional fees?
questions.answer: No hidden fees! Our transparent pricing includes everything: consultation, prescription, and expedited delivery. What you see is what you pay.

questions.question: How is my provider selected?
questions.answer: We carefully match you with a licensed healthcare provider based on your medical history, preferences, and specific needs. All our providers are board-certified and experienced in weight loss management.

questions.question: Do GLP-1s actually work?
questions.answer: Yes! GLP-1 medications have been clinically proven to help with weight loss. Studies show patients typically lose 10-15% of their body weight when combined with lifestyle changes. Results vary by individual.
